propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate has been Lead Engineer and technical lead of a retail bank's card authorisation service since 2022, signing the design reviews for changes to the authorisation path, after software engineer and senior software engineer roles on the same service from 2017 to 2022, eight years of software engineering in all.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the signed design reviews document the lead role and the years.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate holds the bank's secure development certification for the payments domain since 2021, renewed in 2024, led the incident reviews for four authorisation outages under the payments incident review process, and owns the service's technical roadmap.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the certification record and the incident review report document the certification, the reviews and the roadmap.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate mentored the team's six engineers under the engineering mentoring scheme and wrote the boundary note of each signed design review.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the work sample document the mentoring and the boundary notes.

expectedGap: None; the materials document the lead role, the years, the certification, the incident reviews and the mentoring.
expectedBoundaryNote: The lead role, the years and the certification are documented in the resume, the signed reviews and the certification record; the earlier engineer years are shown separately.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the bank's learning record extract for the certification renewal date.
